messages:
olivia: heads up — noticed a regressed P95 on paged-attn after the kernel-chooser tweak in last canary (commit 5b2a9c). p95 for 8k seq model went from 48ms -> 82ms on same infra. traces show a lot more KV page faults and slab churn. :frowning:

raj: ugh. is this only for paged models or also flash variants? any profiler data?

olivia: only observed on paged-attn path. quick perf snapshot:
```
model: gpt-like-8k-paged
kernel-pref: auto (chooser v1.3.2)
batch-config: continuous_batching=on, max_tokens=4096
p95 latency baseline (prev): 48ms
p95 latency now: 82ms
kv page faults/sec: +230%
blocktable-slab-allocs/sec: +5x
```

kim: sounds like kernel chooser is selecting FlashAttnV2 fused kernels that increase temporary working set (extra tiling buffers). on paged setups that pushes more KV pages into pager and triggers eviction spiral. can you repro with FORCE_KERNEL=fused?

olivia: repro steps I used:
```
export KVPAGER_ENABLE=1
export FORCE_KERNEL=auto
python run_inference.py --model paged-8k --batch-size 4 --seq-len 4096 --requests 2000
# collect perf via /usr/local/bin/pager-probe --dump
```
I attached the pager dump (snippet below). noticing hot loops around blocktable::scan_and_pin and kernel memcpy spikes.

maya: if chooser favored FlashAttnV2 because of lower cpu-time for dense models, it may not account for paging cost. we need chooser cost model to include average resident set increase per-kernel and estimated KV page touches. we already have telemetry to estimate kv-touch-rate per kernel, can we feed that back?

dmitri: quick mitigation: 1) add a rule to chooser: if model.use_paged_kv then deprioritize kernels with extra tiling allocation; 2) reduce continuous_batching window for paged models from 30ms->8ms; 3) proactively evict cold KV segments instead of LRU when allocation pressure spikes (prefer slot compaction). I ran a small canary toggling chooser policy and saw p95 go 82ms -> 67ms, and with reduced batching to 8ms -> 54ms.

olivia: great. can someone open an RFC for chooser cost-model change? also want a short-term runtime flag to force 'paged-safe' kernel set.

raj: I'll draft RFC and include perf numbers and k-v pager traces. can we add a smoke test that runs paged path with kernel combos under memory pressure?

infra-bot: deploy notice: canary build 5b2a9c rolled back to 5b2a7f on 3 nodes in us-west-2 at 2026-03-18T14:22:34Z :white_check_mark:

kim: also log note — blocktable fragmentation score increases when slab allocs spike. adding high-frag alerts to pager telemetry is a good idea.

olivia: action items: raj RFC, kim kernel-selector quick flag, dmitri eviction pref change + batch window tweak, maya telemetry feed. I'll collate profiler snippets and attach to the RFC. :thumbsup:
